Twitch Streamer Allegedly Bets Girlfriend As Prize To Little Kids During A Basketball Game, Leading To Horrifying Assault
A disturbing video circulating online has sparked outrage after claiming a 22-year-old streamer offered up his girlfriend as the ultimate prize in a pickup basketball game against a group of kids, with the winner allegedly getting to have her, resulting in her sexual assault.
The clip, posted Wednesday, shows chaotic scenes inside an indoor basketball court and arcade-style facility bathed in purple and pink lighting. Young men in matching neon “LET’S BLOW CRAZY” shirts are seen playing ball, while a pink-haired young woman, identified in the post as the streamer’s girlfriend, interacts with the group.
According to the post’s caption, the streamer, identified as GeologyShi, told the players that whoever won the game could “have his girlfriend.” The video then cuts to tense scenes outside in a parking lot, where the same group, including the pink-haired woman and a young man in a black balaclava and bright pink shirt, is confronted by an older man who appears to be intervening.
Chat overlays visible in the footage suggest the clip was pulled from a livestream or recorded stream session. The woman looks visibly upset during the outdoor confrontation as the group mills around.GeologyShi, a 22-year-old IRL streamer known for YouTube and Twitch content, has not yet publicly responded to the allegations.
He has previously been involved in other online drama, including a 2025 incident where he was slapped by rapper Nine Vicious backstage over comments about a girlfriend.
The video has quickly gained traction, racking up tens of thousands of views within hours, with users expressing shock and disgust at the alleged bet involving what the poster described as “a bunch of kids.”
No police report or official statement has been released yet regarding the incident. The clip does not explicitly show the alleged assault itself, but captures the group dynamics before and after the claimed events.
